requirements.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
requirements.summary: Executor installed createrepo_c, predownloaded httpd and 11 dependency RPMs into /srv/local-repo, ran createrepo_c to generate valid repodata (repomd.xml, primary/filelists/other), and created /etc/yum.repos.d/local-repo.repo pointing to file:///srv/local-repo. The repo was later successfully queried (repoquery) confirming it is a functioning local file:// repository.

requirements.requirement: Install a package from the local repo while the usual remote repositories are unreachable
requirements.summary: Baseline showed remote mirrors.centos.org reachable and dnf makecache succeeding (cmd-a8a9cf85135f41ff). Remote host was then blackholed via /etc/hosts and directly proven unreachable via curl (connection refused) and a failed dnf makecache against a remote repo (curl error 7) (cmd-2c851eeb6e5043d9, cmd-90fd73d99c5645db). With remotes disabled/unreachable, `dnf -y --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=local-repo install httpd` succeeded, installing httpd and 11 dependencies purely from the local repo, confirmed by rpm -q and httpd -v (cmd-d479b58461e1418e, cmd-56265c3936274a6c). Remote connectivity was restored afterward and verified (cmd-cdd3b87d941247b6).

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on node1 (independent of the public task contract)
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id (06339ff3-...) and healthy state (httpd installed, repodata present) were captured (cmd-46c29fd0bedf4c6c), matching the global before_prepare boot-identity snapshot. A backgrounded systemctl reboot returned an acknowledgement before disconnect (cmd-500f805fa42f491d), the node was observably unreachable during the outage (cmd-301b20a392f84ee4, cmd-974859ccbc254d57), then reconnected with a new boot_id (b3dc08f3-...) and fresh uptime (cmd-f1a9de68e50a4eb3), matching the global after_executor boot-identity snapshot. Post-restart recovery of the local repo, repodata, repo config, installed httpd package, and restored remote connectivity was directly verified (cmd-b77e2fc7f1424dbb).

overall_summary: The executor satisfied both material outcomes of the task: it built and served a local file:// package repository from /srv/local-repo on node1 with valid repodata, then demonstrably installed httpd purely from that local repo while the only real remote repository host was made unreachable via a verified /etc/hosts block, with a clean baseline-disruption-restoration sequence. The independently mandated node-restart evidence protocol was also fully and coherently demonstrated, with boot-identity changes cross-checked against the fixed lifecycle snapshots and full post-restart recovery of the local repo, installed package, and remote connectivity.
limitations: A minor leftover file (/tmp/reboot.log) from the backgrounded reboot command was not cleaned up; low-risk and non-functional but represents unnecessary residue.
Reliance on executor-reported command stdout for package/repo verification; no independent tool access was available to re-verify state beyond the provided transcript and fixed lifecycle snapshots.

operational_hygiene.summary: Reviewed all state-changing executor commands chronologically. All mutations map clearly to task outcomes or the mandated restart protocol: package installs (createrepo_c, dnf-plugins-core, httpd+deps) are required inputs/outputs; the /etc/hosts blackhole was a bounded, low-risk disruption that was fully reverted and verified restored (cmd-cdd3b87d941247b6); the local-repo.repo config and /srv/local-repo repository are intentional, expected residue of the task itself, not unwanted mutations; systemctl reboot was required by the independent restart protocol. Global before/after lifecycle diffs confirm no failed services and identical package-health status before and after. One minor unnecessary residue: /tmp/reboot.log, a small log file created by the backgrounded reboot command, was left behind rather than cleaned up (cmd-500f805fa42f491d) — low-risk, bounded, non-destructive, but not removed.
